description: This PHP source file defines the ImportViewError class, a view handler for displaying error pages during the import process in SuiteCRM. It manages menu rendering, module tab identification, and display logic for the error view, including input validation and template rendering.

classes.name: ImportViewError
classes.description: A view handler for error display during import, extending SugarView with methods for menu retrieval, module tab determination, and error page rendering.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Returns the menu HTML for the import error view, customizing based on the module parameter.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Determines the appropriate module tab for display based on request parameters and module mappings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the error page, validating import module and source parameters, assigning template variables, and displaying the error template.
